d: Messy, chin-length jet black hair with long bangs covering the forehead and a small ponytail tied with a white ribbon. Narrow, sharp-eyed eyes of a muted gold shade on a youthful, mature face. A slender build dressed in a white undershirt, beige high-waisted trousers with a silver-buckled belt, and a long, oversized black coat with a metallic silver collar and lapels. Signature details include a gold astrolabe accessory pinned to the right shoulder, a thin gold necklace, black leather boots, and a stack of papers held in one hand.
